name: redact
description: Lets Claude use your API keys, tokens, passwords and other secrets without the model seeing them: what your rules match is swapped for stable placeholders (API_KEY_1) in everything sent to the model, kept in a local vault, and restored in tool calls and your terminal. No rule is on until you turn one on: it starts with two examples (vendor tokens, email addresses), off. A session starts with the secret-shaped values of the env files where it starts (.env, .env.*, *.env, .envrc, .dev.vars, .flaskenv, a compose file's env_file) already masked. Rules live in ~/.claude/redact-rules.json, each with its own pattern, replacement label and on/off switch; manage them with /redact. Fails closed.

patterns.title: Extra patterns
patterns.description: Patterns in /redact add's short form (LABEL [options]: regex, or a bare regex masked as SECRET), always on, masked after the rules file's. A list, so set it in settings.json pluginConfigs: /config does not show list fields
